description: 5-dimension lead scoring model for SME Thanh Hoa lead qualification

dimensions.name: Digital Need
dimensions.description: Does the business need a better website and/or chatbot? (1=low, 5=high)

dimensions.name: Revenue Fit
dimensions.description: Can the business afford 12.9M? Revenue signal from review volume, premises, staff. (1=low, 5=high)

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.description: How easy is it to reach the decision maker? Owner-operated = 5, large corp = 1.

dimensions.name: Pain Intensity
dimensions.description: How intense is their customer service bottleneck? Many unanswered comments/reviews = high pain. (1=low, 5=high)

dimensions.name: Decision Speed
dimensions.description: How fast can they decide? Owner-ops businesses with <5 staff decide in days. (1=slow, 5=fast)

hot.label: Hot Lead — Contact in first 3 days

cold.label: Cold Lead — Park for later cycle

scoring_formula: weighted_score = sum(dimension_score * weight for each dimension) + vertical_priority_bonus
note: DEMO MODEL — Weights and thresholds should be calibrated with real conversion data after first 30 days of outreach.
